main_text.p: otio deditæ, corrumpuntur, sequieres fiunt, corpora red-duntur languidiora. Et ut pul-li equini, ni paulatim oneribus ferendis idonei reddantur, fa-cilè delassantur: ita & militiæ destinati, ni ab ineunte ætate armis tractandis adhibeantur, post minus apti erunt, nec o-nera militibus impofita nec moleftias, quas secum trahit il-lud artis genus, perferre pote-runt, aut pati.

Exemplo hoc ipsum testa-tum fecerunt Lacędemonii, qui quamvis pauci admodum ef-sent numero, parum tamen aberat, quin universam Græ-ciam sibi subjecisset. Quod reliqui præter illos, nonnisi de-sidiæ ac voluptati, ludisque non ad usum institutis, vaca-rent. Nec Romani virtute ac gloriâ cæteros mortales olim antecessissent, nisi apud ipsos armorū exercitatio floruisset.

page.notes: Long s normalised to plain s throughout, including in ligatures (ss). Printed "s" in "moleftias", "subjecisset" and similar words is read as s. "Unde" is the catchword at the foot. The printed page number reads "4ı", taken here as 41. No marginal notes, signature or footnotes are printed on this page. The words "sequieres", "red-duntur" and "tractandis" are copied as printed and are doubtful in the scan.
